paper_title: When Does Factor Identifiability Yield Reliable Slow Representations?
scope: synthetic NumPy simulation plus read-only sealed JSON overlays; no training or archived evaluation rerun

phase_grid.readout: z + sqrt(1-R2) iid unit Gaussian noise

harmonic.oracle_control: latent linear coordinates plus exact Hermite2, diagnostic only
harmonic.caution: observed Poly2 span need not contain exact latent harmonic

residuals: fast-axis slow leakage rho=.94, slow-axis residual rho=.5
subspace.labels: latent truth used only for audit and oracle naming diagnostic

stress.fast_formula: sqrt(signal_fraction) z_fast + leak z_slow + noise_sd iid white noise
stress.audit_rule: measure actual state MSE R2; do not equate signal_fraction to R2 or claim .85 necessary

interpretation_commitments: Population boundary SNR is not same-window reconstruction error probability.
Nuisance noise temporal spectrum and direction are explicit, not inferred from scalar R2.
Grid T_min is an observed minimum among tested lengths, not a universal finite-sample guarantee.
All anchors remain archived neural results; sandbox differences are descriptive and not causal attribution.
No requirement that hypotheses produce positive or sharp transitions.
